_comment: Milo in the Village (inside the fence by the start). The FIRST dialogue of the game - no choices here (author).

lines.text: Oh! Hey. Sorry, didn't see you there.
You're new, right? Yeah. You've got that look. The "where am I and why is the grass this green" look.
...Where am I?
The Village. Nice, quiet, smells like fresh bread most mornings. I'm Milo, by the way.
Everybody here kind of does their own thing. Nobody asks too many questions. It's a good place.
Past the forest it gets louder, though. There's a meadow so colourful it hurts your eyes. Rainbow Fields, people call it.
And past that... more places. Sweeter ones. Colder ones. I haven't been everywhere. Not yet.
Is it safe out there?
Mostly! There are monsters. Cute ones. Cute and bitey.
But they leave you alone on the paths. Stay on the road and you're fine. Step into the grass and, well. They notice.
If a fight goes really bad, hold R and run. No shame in that. Running is a perfectly good strategy.
Do you run a lot?
Professionally.
Oh, and the ways between the lands? Something always stands guard there. Big. Grumpy. You'll know it when you see it.
Anyway. Welcome, outsider. Look around, meet people. Just... try not to get lost, okay?
Still here? Good. The Village needs people who stay.
Remember: path good, grass bitey. That's basically all of my wisdom.
Hold R if it gets bad. I know I keep saying it. I'll keep saying it.
You walk like someone who's looking for something. Everyone's looking for something here, I guess.
The bread lady makes the best rolls in the world. Don't tell her I said "bread lady".
